purpose: Unisermo temporal semantics diagnostics; never use as the naturally diverse comprehension corpus

cases.meaning_it: Il chirurgo ha lavato le mani prima di entrare in sala operatoria.
cases.intended_semantics_en: washing hands finished before entering begins
cases.do_not_infer_en: Past tense on both events is not itself the order.

cases.meaning_it: Il tecnico ha riavviato il server dopo aver salvato i dati.
cases.intended_semantics_en: saving completes before restart begins; invert event order with a single BEFORE relation
cases.do_not_infer_en: Do not force a separate 'after' root before usability screening.

cases.meaning_it: La bambina disegnava mentre fuori pioveva.
cases.intended_semantics_en: some time spent drawing overlaps the raining interval
cases.do_not_infer_en: Neither event has to start or end at the same time as the other.

cases.meaning_it: Ho iniziato a leggere prima che squillasse il telefono, e stavo ancora leggendo quando squillò.
cases.intended_semantics_en: onset of reading precedes ringing; reading remains in progress at ring time
cases.do_not_infer_en: Full reading interval need not be strictly before the ring; onset is the relevant landmark.

cases.meaning_it: Il documento era già stato spedito quando il cliente ha chiamato.
cases.intended_semantics_en: shipping is complete before call; 'already' adds a contextual earliness/expectation contribution
cases.do_not_infer_en: Completive aspect alone cannot automatically encode the pragmatic 'already'.

cases.meaning_it: Il treno era ancora fermo quando il semaforo è diventato verde.
cases.intended_semantics_en: train remains stationary at the signal-change reference time
cases.do_not_infer_en: Persistence may be expressible with a phase root, but not all expectation readings of 'still'.

cases.meaning_it: Ieri l'ufficio era chiuso, oggi è aperto.
cases.intended_semantics_en: two distinct calendar-day intervals anchored to the speech day

cases.meaning_it: La consegna deve avvenire entro dieci minuti dalla conferma.
cases.intended_semantics_en: elapsed time from confirmation to delivery must be <=10 minutes
cases.do_not_infer_en: A duration quantity alone is not a deadline between two events.

cases.meaning_it: Se il volo è cancellato, prenderemo un treno dopo pranzo.
cases.intended_semantics_en: the conditional does not assert cancellation; lunch is a time/event anchor for later train travel
cases.do_not_infer_en: Alor means conditional consequent, not narrative then; before/after NP is not yet specified.

cases.meaning_it: La strada è bagnata perché ha piovuto.
cases.intended_semantics_en: rain is offered as a real-world cause of wetness
cases.do_not_infer_en: Temporal precedence alone does not express factual cause; use independently ratified due when appropriate.

cases.meaning_it: Non ho aperto la porta finché non è arrivato il custode.
cases.intended_semantics_en: non-opening persists up to arrival; may or may not end in an opening after arrival depending context
cases.do_not_infer_en: A negative non-event is not automatically an event suitable as BEFORE operand.

cases.meaning_it: Appena è terminato il concerto, il pubblico è uscito.
cases.intended_semantics_en: exit closely follows the end of the concert with near-zero contextual delay
cases.do_not_infer_en: Ordinary strict-before does not entail immediately afterward.

cases.meaning_it: Quando il vento aumenta, le finestre tremano.
cases.intended_semantics_en: generic/iterative association between wind-increase occasions and window shaking
cases.do_not_infer_en: Simple temporal overlap is not automatically universal/habitual when.

cases.meaning_it: Mi ha detto che sarebbe partito il giorno seguente.
cases.intended_semantics_en: departure is future relative to past reporting event, not necessarily future relative to speech now
cases.do_not_infer_en: Tensed propositional serviles do not automatically license reported-speech valency for dik.
